question: Please analyze our interest data from September 2018 to August 2019. For each month, calculate the average composition for each interest by dividing the composition by the index value. Identify the interest with the highest average composition value each month and report its average composition as the max index composition for that month. Compute the three-month rolling average of these monthly max index compositions. Ensure the output includes the date, the interest name, the max index composition for that month, the rolling average, and the names and max index compositions of the top interests from one month ago and two months ago.
sql:
-- Full solution with interest names, rolling average, and previous months' data
WITH monthly_data AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        composition,
        index_value,
        composition / index_value AS avg_composition,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(month_year, '-', 1) AS INTEGER) as month_num,
        TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(month_year, '-', 2) AS INTEGER) as year_num
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE month_year IS NOT NULL
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM monthly_data
    WHERE (year_num > 2018) OR (year_num = 2018 AND month_num >= 9)
       OR (year_num = 2019 AND month_num <= 8)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition,
        month_num,
        year_num,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY month_num, year_num ORDER BY avg_composition DESC) as rn
    FROM filtered
),
monthly_max AS (
    SELECT 
        month_year,
        interest_id,
        avg_composition as max_index_composition,
        month_num,
        year_num
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_names AS (
    SELECT 
        mm.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        mm.max_index_composition,
        mm.month_num,
        mm.year_num,
        AVG(mm.max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY mm.year_num, mm.month_num
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_3month
    FROM monthly_max mm
    LEFT JOIN interest_map im ON mm.interest_id = im.id
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        wn.*,
        LAG(wn.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_month_interest,
        LAG(wn.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_month_max_composition,
        LAG(wn.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_2months_interest,
        LAG(wn.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_2months_max_composition
    FROM with_names wn
)
SELECT 
    month_year as date,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    rolling_avg_3month,
    prev_month_interest,
    prev_month_max_composition,
    prev_2months_interest,
    prev_2months_max_composition
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY year_num, month_num

    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_names AS (
    SELECT 
        mm.month_year,
        im.interest_name,
        mm.max_index_composition,
        mm.month_num,
        mm.year_num,
        AVG(mm.max_index_composition) OVER (
            ORDER BY mm.year_num, mm.month_num
            ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) as rolling_avg_3month
    FROM monthly_max mm
    LEFT JOIN interest_map im ON mm.interest_id = im.id
),
with_lag AS (
    SELECT 
        wn.*,
        LAG(wn.interest_name, 1) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_month_interest,
        LAG(wn.max_index_composition, 1) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_month_max_composition,
        LAG(wn.interest_name, 2) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_2months_interest,
        LAG(wn.max_index_composition, 2) OVER (ORDER BY wn.year_num, wn.month_num) as prev_2months_max_composition
    FROM with_names wn
)
SELECT 
    month_year as date,
    interest_name,
    max_index_composition,
    rolling_avg_3month,
    prev_month_interest,
    prev_month_max_composition,
    prev_2months_interest,
    prev_2months_max_composition
FROM with_lag
ORDER BY year_num, month_num
